description:
We're Hanna and Taylor, the dynamic duo assisting you in a smooth transition to the Fort Cavazos area. Whether you're in need of assistance with housing, looking for food to activity recommendations or just want to chat about what to expect living here, we're happy to help you make Fort Cavazos feel like home! 

🚨 Subscribe to this channel here: 👇👇👇👇👇👇👇
✅ https://www.youtube.com/ ‪@LivingatFortCavazos‬ 

👉 Download The Ultimate Fort Cavazos Relocation Guide Here: https://simplebooklet.com/2025pcsguide

📲 Hanna is a Killeen area native and we're both Military spouse.
We understand the stressors of PCSing. Please reach out anytime, including nights and weekends!

Hanna Smelser + Taylor Cebulski
📲 Call/Text 254.702.2883
📲 Email: CavazosHousing@gmail.com 
JOIN US ON FB:   / 19lnbakevk
